environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running in us-east-1 VPC with default IMDSv1 enabled. Application deployed as systemd service directly on the instance. pgBouncer running locally in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement support. Security group allows outbound to 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 80/443. No iptables rules restricting access to link-local addresses from the application process. Instance has IAM role 'LegacyAppRole' with S3 and DynamoDB permissions attached.
